subject: Quick recap + last check — should I close this out?
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Kevin Patel <kevin.patel@asterbio.com>, Evan Moore <evan@consult-ops.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap from today’s demo + next steps

Hi Kevin / Evan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we covered:
- Redwood inference overview and hosting options (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)
- Typical deployed topology for regulated workloads (private control plane + KMS integration)
- Typical economics: batching + KV caching reduced token-costs by ~30% for similar workloads

Your priorities (as discussed):
1) Data isolation and audit logging for clinical workloads (high)
2) Low latency for triage assistant use case (medium-high)
3) Budget guardrails for pilot (medium)

Proposed next steps:
- Marcus to share a short sizing note and SOW sketch for a 6-week pilot (I’ve attached the SOW draft + quickstart + pricing matrix).
- Kevin to confirm who on procurement should be looped in (you mentioned procurement@asterbio.com).
- Schedule an architecture/ops call next week to review the VPC/KMS checklist if procurement is comfortable.

Attachments: SOW-draft-AsterBio.docx, redwood-quickstart.pdf, redwood-pricing-matrix.xlsx

If anything above is off, please flag and I’ll update. Otherwise, no action needed until procurement confirms a PO path — I’ll follow up on Monday.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for production LLMs
From: Dr. Kevin Patel <kevin.patel@asterbio.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Moore <evan@consult-ops.com>, procurement <procurement@asterbio.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick recap from today’s demo + next steps

Thanks Jasmine — appreciated the clear recap. A few quick notes: 

1) Procurement looped in (procurement@asterbio.com) — they’ll review SOW and reach back with required controls.
2) We’re aligned on data isolation and audit logs — can Marcus include the SOC 2 evidence references in the SOW appendix?
3) Timeline: target pilot start late Oct. Budget will likely need a short internal approval but we’re optimistic.

I’ll wait for the SOW and Marcus’s sizing note. Thanks again.

Best,
Kevin
Dr. Kevin Patel
Head of Digital Pathology | AsterBio
kevin.patel@asterbio.com

Subject: SOW sketch and SOC 2 references attached

Kevin / procurement team —

Attached is the SOW sketch we discussed and a short appendix with SOC 2 and KMS integration notes. Marcus included two sizing options (single-node private deployment for stricter isolation, and a dedicated pool option for predictable throughput). Pricing matrix attached for side-by-side comparison.

Action items I’m proposing:
- Procurement: confirm whether the single-node private option requires an external audit / additional paperwork (procurement@asterbio.com)
- Kevin: if timeline still looks late Oct for pilot start, confirm and we’ll lock an internal slot on our Dedicated calendar.
- Marcus: can you please add the SOC 2 artifact links to the Drive doc (I’ve shared the link below)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSOW-draft
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/AST-4821

Thanks — I’ll keep this open and follow up next week if I don’t hear back.

Regards,
Jasmine

Date: Sat, 25 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Closing the loop — still prioritizing AsterBio?

Hi Kevin / procurement team —

Hope you’re doing well. I wanted to check in since I haven’t seen a response to the SOW we sent on the 16th. I realize procurement cycles can take time — two quick options from my side so we’re not pinging indefinitely: 

Option A — You’re still interested: please reply with a one-line update (e.g., \"procurement reviewing, expect answer by Oct 8\") and I’ll keep the pilot slot tentatively held.
Option B — You’ve deprioritized: reply \"please close\" and I’ll archive the deal to keep our pipeline tidy.

If I don’t hear back by Oct 2 I’ll archive the file and free the slot — happy to reopen if timing changes. No hard feelings either way.

Thanks for the candid update — it helps us plan capacity.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

If helpful, Marcus and I can jump on a 15-minute Q/A with procurement to speed things up.
